title: Measure before you trust
description: I don't ship a retrieval or ranking change without something to compare against — labeled queries beat demos.

title: Reliability beats cleverness
description: A boring design that fails loudly is worth more than a clever one that fails silently.

title: Humans own irreversible decisions
description: Hiring, client email, payments — models draft; people confirm.

title: Prefer deterministic over magical
description: LLMs propose. Code validates, scores, and decides what is allowed to stick.

title: Keep the surface small
description: I extract shared code after the third repetition. Premature frameworks cost more than duplication.
